opening.argument: The performance plainly presents a humorous country song about computer problems, beginning with the stated purpose to “write a country song about technical difficulties.” Its lyrics describe a computer locking up and then turn to a comic troubleshooting exchange, including “I will help you troubleshoot!” The visible staging of a performer at a microphone with an acoustic guitar confirms that this is a live comedy and music performance. The exaggerated wording about shooting a computer therefore appears within that comedic song, while the described material contains no financial offer, payment request, credential request, or audience solicitation.

citations.quote: I thought it was time to, uh, to write a country song about technical difficulties
